notes.title: Steam Cloud and MacOS Build Added
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce an update for [i]Free Stars: The Ur-Quan Masters[/i]:
[list]
[*] MacOS build added to Steam.
[*] Steam Cloud enabled with automatic cloud saves.
[/list]

Please note that cloud saves are platform specific, with Windows/Deck save data separate from MacOS save data.

notes.title: Kickstarter for Free Stars: Children of Infinity Surpasses Goals!
notes.notes:
[h1]Happy Days and Jubilation![/h1]

On April 16th, we launched our Kickstarter for [i][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pistolshrimp/free-stars-children-of-infinity]Free Stars: Children of Infinity[/url][/i], and within just over 3 hours, it was fully funded!

[previewyoutube=MqCnsE3hxP4;full][/previewyoutube]

Our Kickstarter still has several stretch goals to go, from adding voice acting all the way up to completely open-sourcing the entire game and engine. Along the way, there are plenty of digital and physical collectors' goodies for fans of [i]The Ur-Quan Masters[/i] to enjoy.

If you haven't already, check out our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pistolshrimp/free-stars-children-of-infinity]Kickstarter[/url] and help us make the sequel to [i]Free Stars: The Ur-Quan Masters[/i] the best it can be!

Thank you, and don't forget to *enjoy the sauce*.

notes.title: Free Stars: Children of Infinity Kickstarter
notes.notes:
[h1]Launch Fighters![/h1]
On April 16th at 7am PT, we are excited to launch our Kickstarter for [i][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pistolshrimp/free-stars-children-of-infinity]Free Stars: Children of Infinity[/url][/i]. Haven’t gotten a good look at the game in a while? Be sure to check out our [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MqCnsE3hxP4]Kickstarter trailer[/url].

[previewyoutube=MqCnsE3hxP4;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re using Kickstarter to raise funds which will help us see our game to completion and create the sequel to [i]The Ur-Quan Masters[/i] that we dream of. There might even be a few things in it for you too…

[h1]Backer Rewards[/h1]
Beyond some unique digital rewards, we’re also creating some cool physical collectibles. Whether you want to immerse yourself in our handmade art and stories, long for a beautiful starmap to hang on your wall, or simply wish to don your Captain’s regalia with pride, we have a variety of treats we think you’ll enjoy.
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pistolshrimp/free-stars-children-of-infinity][img]https://i0.wp.com/pistolshrimpgames.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/physical_rewards_arrangement.png[/img][/url]

We’ve entered full production mode only with the confidence that we can finish what we started and that we think we have something really cool. After nearly three years of self-funding, along with the help of our [url=https://www.patreon.com/pistolshrimp]Patreon[/url] community we’ve assembled, we are asking for your support to take this project across the finish line and make it the best it can be.

We are grateful for all of you helping to keep the Free Stars universe alive all these years. We hope you’re as excited for this as we are, and we can’t wait to launch our campaign on the 16th. Hope to see you all on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pistolshrimp/free-stars-children-of-infinity/]Kickstarter[/url]!

[img]https://i0.wp.com/pistolshrimpgames.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/6meleeships_optimized.gif?resize=700%2C394&ssl=1[/img]

notes.title: Free Stars: The Ur-Quan Masters Available to Play
notes.notes:
[b]LAUNCH FIGHTERS![/b] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2645580/Free_Stars_The_UrQuan_Masters/]Free Stars: The Ur-Quan Masters[/url] is now available to download, play, and celebrate on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2645580/Free_Stars_The_UrQuan_Masters/]Steam[/url]! If you’ve never experienced the award-winning space saga before, it’s now easier to play than ever. If you know someone who hasn’t, now it’s even easier for them too. [url=https://www.twitch.tv/bikeman/]BikeMan[/url] will be hosting us on a special stream tonight to celebrate and play the game.

But our mission has only begun. The Alliance of Free Stars still needs you!

[h1]Get The Word Out[/h1]

We don’t know how to tell you this, but there are real, live people out there – some of which who may naively claim to know true happiness – who have not experienced [i]The Ur-Quan Masters[/i]. We know… we know. We’re shocked, appalled, and turgid too.

Captain, those people need your help! They need to know we are out here, they are not alone, and they are not only welcome in our mighty fleet, but a key to our success in the journey to come. We must task you with an important mission: spread the word and inform those who are unaware of [i]Free Stars: The Ur-Quan Masters[/i]!

[h1]Priority Override: Contact Alien Species[/h1]

The universe is vast, and fans of amazing games inhabit their own spheres of influence. Venture forth, spreading word of [i]Free Stars: The Ur-Quan Masters[/i]. Share the Steam page, our website, and articles others may write about it!
[list][*]Share online on social media outlets like Twitter, Facebook, and Reddit.[/*][*]Post in gaming communities like forums you’re a part of.[/*][*]Distribute video content you record on Twitch and YouTube as live streams, lets-plays, or deeply thoughtful video essays on Juffo-Wup.[/*][/list]

If you know content creators you love in any of those spaces, like other streamers, writers, or people who like sharing information about games, tell them about the game too. They, too, can be powerful allies!

[h1]New Behavior Dictated: Full Steam Ahead[/h1]

Being on Steam is the most special part of our new release, and you can participate there too. In the vastness of gaming space, anything that helps us stand out will help new players be excited to pick it up.
[list][*]If you’ve played it, leave a review so your friends and enemies can know how you feel. The more reviews we get, the more everyone will know just how many people have gotten to play this game. Even Darwin would agree: one thumb goes a long way.[/*][*]Help other players find the game by tagging the release with your favorite tags. Steam doesn’t have a “best game of all time” tag, but perhaps something like [b]Cult Classic[/b] will do.[/*][*]Participate in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2645580]community hub[/url] by sharing guides, fan art, and screenshots you love.[/*][/list]

[h1]More to Come[/h1]

As a reminder, we are also out there helping to spread the word of [i]Free Stars: The Ur-Quan Masters[/i] with you and giving you things you can share with your communities beyond just the game too! Last week, we shared [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=afp3WMgINJ0]our discussion[/url] with Tim Cain, who also is a big fan. We have plenty more to come, and we’ll be sharing another chat with Ken Levine on the 20th. Subscribe to our [url=https://www.youtube.com/@pistolshrimpgames]YouTube channel[/url] to catch all the goods as they emerge, or join us on [url=https://www.patreon.com/pistolshrimp]Patreon[/url] to get early access to even more.

We’re excited to have you as part of our mission, and this is just the start. We have more to come soon for our current project. Follow along at [url=https://pistolshrimpgames.com/blog/]our blog[/url].

Join us on[url=https://www.reddit.com/r/uqm2/] Reddit[/url],[url=https://www.patreon.com/pistolshrimp] Patreon[/url], and[url=https://discord.gg/rasVCDmYKp] Discord[/url] to support the Alliance of Free Stars and be part of the awesome community!

notes.title: Star Control 2 becomes Free Stars: The Ur-Quan Masters on Steam next week
notes.notes:
Free Stars: The Ur-Quan Masters will make its way to Steam on February 19th. It's a version of 1992 strategy classic Star Control 2 that takes advantage of updates from its long-running open source project, and it'll be completely free.

Read more

notes.title: More than 20 years after its debut, revered sci-fi adventure The Ur-Quan Masters is finally coming to Steam next week
notes.notes: The Ur-Quan Masters, an open-source remake of the revered sci-fi exploration-adventure Star Control 2, is coming to Steam next week, free for all and with a slightly different title—Free Stars: The Ur-Quan Masters... Read more.

notes.title: Free Stars: The Ur-Quan Masters on Steam February 19th
notes.notes:
Everyone on Earth will be able to play [i]Free Stars: The Ur-Quan Masters [/i]on Steam next week starting [b]Monday, February 19th[/b].

We’re releasing on Steam so more people get to play and experience the fun of [i]Free Stars: The Ur-Quan Masters[/i], and we just need you to help us get the word out. A few suggestions:

[list][*]Share the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2645580/Free_Stars_The_UrQuan_Masters/]Steam page[/url] anywhere and everywhere you can. Social media, antisocial media, awkward family dinners, your local newspaper, a propeller plane towing a banner, or one of those Super Bowl blimp things with an advertisement on it. We’re not picky![/*]
[*]Stream the game on Twitch under [url=https://www.twitch.tv/directory/category/the-ur-quan-masters]The Ur-Quan Masters[/url] category, or convince your favorite streamer to play, and help us show the game to more people! If you are streaming on launch week, tag us on [url=https://twitter.com/theurquanmaster]Twitter[/url] and we’ll share it with our communities as well and maybe even drop in to watch.[/*][/list]
[previewyoutube=ca-9G15qQrE;full][/previewyoutube]

For this mission to succeed, we will need awesome strength, both in our flagship as well as the assistance of powerful, new allies. Help us find them! The bigger the fleet we bring in to join the Alliance of Free Stars, the more our ongoing work on the forthcoming sequel will be a success. We cannot win the fight alone, Captain. We will need allies.

[h1]Channel 44 on YouTube[/h1]
Speaking of growing our fleet, we’re also excited to announce a video podcast series entitled [u]Channel 44[/u], where we talk with other game developers who graciously spare some of their time to talk with us about their love of [i]The Ur-Quan Masters[/i], game development, and anything else we were excited about. We will be posting it regularly on [url=https://www.youtube.com/@pistolshrimpgames]YouTube[/url] and distributing in audio form through the [url=https://pistolshrimpgames.com/2022/12/pistol-shrimp-podcast-now-syndicated-everywhere/]Pistol Shrimp Podcast[/url].

Here’s the schedule of our first few discussions, with more to come too:
[list][*]February 13: [url=https://www.youtube.com/@CainOnGames]Tim Cain[/url] ([i]Fallout, Arcanum, The Outer Worlds[/i])[/*]
[*]February 20: Ken Levine from [url=https://www.ghoststorygames.com/]Ghost Story Games[/url] ([i]BioShock, System Shock 2[/i])[/*]
[*]February 27: Chris Remo from [url=https://www.camposanto.com/]Campo Santo[/url] ([i]Firewatch, Half-Life: Alyx[/i])[/*]
[*]March 5: [url=https://www.youtube.com/@MarkDarrah]Mark Darrah[/url] ([i]Mass Effect, Dragon Age, Baldur’s Gate[/i])[/*]
[*]March 11: Henrik Fåhraeus from [url=https://www.paradoxinteractive.com/our-games/discover]Paradox Interactive[/url] ([i]Stellaris, Crusader Kings[/i])[/*][/list]

Our [url=https://www.patreon.com/pistolshrimp]Patreon[/url] supporters will receive early access links to enjoy the entire bundle — ad-free — tomorrow!

We hope you enjoy learning more about us and about other game developers who were part of making some of the games we enjoyed too. At Pistol Shrimp, we believe making games with our community is one of our greatest strengths. With no shortage of news on how many game developers are struggling, the world needs more of what we’re doing together. Help us make a success story together for the [i]Free Stars[/i] universe, and we can ensure there will be more successes to come.

Join us on [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/uqm2/]Reddit[/url], [url=https://www.patreon.com/pistolshrimp]Patreon[/url], and [url=https://discord.gg/rasVCDmYKp]Discord[/url] to be a part of the community and let us know what you think.
